These are consistent with common AI generation failures in complex human-object interactions. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these structural issues because it only looks for graphic distortions (noise/blur), so the Router's visual observation remains the primary evidence for these defects. The severity of the text artifact is high enough to significantly impact the overall quality score.
